description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Merge commit of data-connect#94 into PDP-Connect/data-connect main (merged 2026-09-11T16:12:13Z), captured via `gh pr view 94 --json mergeCommit` and confirmed an ancestor of main — never a PR head, for the reason the superseded-pin history below records. Moved from 1577a34e5 (data-connect#89's merge) because #94 rewrote packages/connector-protocol/src/auth.ts (+107 lines), a PACKED INPUT of @pdpp/connector-protocol, so data-connect's own packages/connector-protocol/artifact.json receipt moved with it (source_inputs_sha256 9a14f07f9 -> c1b12ed67, artifact_sha256 2d683a301 -> 7a937c137). That made this repo's recorded pin name a commit that no longer describes the vendored tarball, which fails data-connect's consumer-drift-signal check on every data-connect PR touching a guarded path, regardless of what that PR changes. packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz is repacked from THIS commit in the same PR and vendor/SHA256SUMS updated to 7a937c137af0b3208635aad1bd73f56a584de73ce8903255a6b2c6e1b9d0831d, which matches data-connect's own artifact.json artifact_sha256 at this SHA — the repack reproduces upstream's receipt rather than merely agreeing with itself. The repack is confined to dist/auth.js and dist/auth.d.ts; every other file in the tarball is byte-identical. pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz is deliberately NOT re-vendored: #94 did not touch collector-runtime's packed inputs, and a fresh repack at this SHA reproduces the committed digest e274fb459 exactly, so drift jobs (a) collector-definitions, (b) connector-sources, (c) tarball-digests and (e) collector-packaging-manifest all pass at this SHA (verified by running each script locally against a clean checkout of this commit). data-connect#64 is NOT satisfied by this pin and needs its own later repin: it is still open, branched from the superseded 1577a34e5 pin, and has not been rebased onto #94 — its head would REVERSE #94's auth.ts and additionally moves packages/collector-runtime/artifact.json, so it must rebase and regenerate both receipts before it merges, and this repo repins again afterwards. Supersedes the temporary 27fe8086d pin, which tracked the unmerged branch chore/revendor-connectors-92 so the paired trees could be compared before #89 landed. A pin on an unmerged branch cannot stay valid: data-connect's consumer-drift-signal workflow requires the pinned commit to exist in its own checkout, and a pull-request merge ref cannot reach a commit that lives only on an unrelated branch. When #89 was rebased, 27fe8086d stopped being reachable from any ref, so every data-connect pull request touching a guarded path failed on the pin lookup regardless of what it changed. Pinning a merged main commit removes that failure mode. This SHA still carries data-connect#89's vendored malformed-line isolation and Claude/Codex symlink disclosure sources from data-connectors#92, unchanged by #94. Collector definitions are unchanged, and the separate 1.0.0 release pin remains unchanged. This pin also backs drift job (e) local-collector packaging manifest: it supplies packages/local-collector/tsconfig.build.json, the compile list that job compares against this repo's connector registry.

data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from data-connect PR #36's tree — this is PR #36's merge commit into main ('Add local collection and release checks', merged 2026-09-02T07:53:00Z), superseding the prior 10f25a3cd6 pin which recorded the PR's pre-merge head commit. Confirmed via `git diff 10f25a3cd6..b70dda89a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts` (empty — the merge is a true two-parent merge of the reviewed branch, not a squash, so the packages this pin backs are byte-identical between the two commits; the merge additionally picked up an unrelated repo-wide SPDX-header sweep and other main-tip drift, none of it touching these paths) that the previously-vendored 1.0.0 tarballs still reconcile: no re-vendor needed, this is a SHA-reference-only update. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the `data-connect` pin above and this one (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp main on 2026-09-09 after PRs #342, #348, #349, #350, and #351 merged. Refreshes the pin after dependency updates changed packages/reference-contract/package.json on the tracked path. The copied reference-contract modules and vendored archives remain unchanged.
